text: ひとりで　いっても　ダメだぞ　だれか　ともだちを　つれてけよ

structure.jp: ひとりで　いっても　ダメだぞ
structure.en: even if you go alone, it's no good

structure.jp: だれか　ともだちを　つれてけよ

patterns.name: 〜ても
patterns.explanation: も after a て-form means 'even if' you do it. ひとりで いっても ダメだ = 'even if you go alone, it's no good'.

patterns.name: 〜ていく
patterns.explanation: つれてけ is the short spoken form of つれていけ, a blunt order to bring someone and go. ともだちを つれてけ = 'take a friend along'.

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end is rough, manly talk that presses a warning on the listener. ダメだぞ = 'it's no good, I'm telling you'.
